verdict.rationale: The pipeline describes the dor.wa.gov guidance pages as open, and quoted guidance text was gathered from several of them; the probes got ordinary 404 responses there rather than a challenge page. The login wall on secure.dor.wa.gov covers the transactional portal, not the public reading surface. missing for 10: a direct probe confirming guidance pages return HTTP 200 with server-rendered content to an identified user agent, explicit evidence of no CAPTCHA or bot wall across the guidance surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: the agency is judged from its open dor.wa.gov guidance pages plus this recorded wall
Businesses can find the tax rate that applies to the appropriate tax classification on our list of B&O tax rates.
